newsitem.title: USA: Forstmann reorganization wins court OK.
newsitem.headline: Forstmann reorganization wins court OK.

text.p: Forstmann & Co Inc said Wednesday a U.S. Bankruptcy Judge for the Southern District of New York approved the company's plan of reorganization.
Jude James Garrity Jr.'s decision allows Forstmann to emerge from bankruptcy protection on or about July 21, after it concludes its financial restructuring.
The textile company has been under bankruptcy protection since September 22, 1995.
Rod Peckham, Forstmann's chief financial officer, said in a press release that the company has cut its long-term debt almost in half.
"We are pleased with our results through the first half of fiscal year 1997 and are optimistic about the remainder of fiscal year 1997," he said.

The reorganization plan is primarily an equity conversion plan in which pre-petition general unsecured claims against Forstmann will get common stock of the restructured company while the secured claims will be either refinanced or reinstated.
The exit financing will be provided by a syndicate, led by BankAmerica Business Credit Inc, that will offer up to about $116 million of new financing, the company said.
Forstmann, which will have a new board of directors after Chapter 11, is seaching for a permanent chief executive.
